name: Electric Consumption And Cost (2010 - Sep 2025)
description:
This dataset contains electricity consumption and billing records for New York City housing developments, covering service periods from 2010 through September 2025. Each row represents a utility bill or service period for a specific account, identified by development name, borough, account name, location, meter number, and rate class. Records include billing dates and service length, consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) and kilowatts (kW), and itemized charges for current, kWh, kW, and other costs. Additional fields describe the funding source, vendor, meter type, and whether the bill was estimated or analyzed.

The data supports analysis of electricity usage and cost across developments and boroughs, benchmarking of energy efficiency, identification of high-consumption buildings or rate classes, budget forecasting, and evaluation of sustainability or energy-reduction initiatives. It could also assist auditors and housing administrators in reviewing utility spending and billing accuracy.
